definitions.explanation: The community of people one interacts with; the general public and its opinions.

examples.japanese: {世間|せけん}は{狭|せま}いものだ。
examples.notes: Common expression when unexpectedly meeting someone

examples.japanese: {世間|せけん}の{目|め}を{気|き}にしすぎる。
examples.english: You worry too much about what others think.

examples.japanese: {世間|せけん}{知|し}らずだと{言|い}われた。
examples.english: I was told I don't know the ways of the world.

notes:
{世間|せけん} refers to society as experienced personally, emphasizing social perception and opinion.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {世間|せけん}は{狭|せま}い (It's a small world)
- {世間|せけん}の{目|め} (public eye, what people think)
- {世間|せけん}{体|てい} (keeping up appearances)
- {世間|せけん}{話|ばなし} (small talk, gossip)
- {世間|せけん}{知|し}らず (naïve, ignorant of the world)

COMPARISON:
- {世間|せけん}: society (personal sphere, social judgment)
- {社会|しゃかい}: society (formal, institutional)
- {世界|せかい}: world (global, physical world)
